# `comment_periods`

**Public comment periods**

One row per continuous public-comment interval, reopenings included: overlapping or adjacent intervals from Regulations.gov documents and Register notices of the same dockets (else the same proceedings) merge into one, so an extension lengthens a period and a reopening starts a new one. A period keeps its docket anchors when its proceeding is unresolved. Keyed `comment_period_id`. Its proceedings, dockets and RINs are JSON lists, so it joins through them rather than by a column. Built by `build_comment_periods`; all columns are VARCHAR.

**Coverage.** Derived, and bounded by its inputs: `documents` with a comment end date and `federal_register` records with `comments_close_on`. `snapshot_91b19da7…` holds 281,635 periods. *(measured 2026-09-27)*

- **Parquet file:** `comment_periods.parquet`, in the snapshot that `materialized/rulemaking/latest.json` names
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `comment_period_id` | `VARCHAR` | Stable id of the period (`comment_period_<24 hex>`), from its proceedings, dockets and open date. |
| `proceeding_ids_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of the proceedings the period is open in; `[]` when none resolves (docket-only). |
| `rins_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of the RINs its documents and proceedings carry. |
| `docket_ids_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of the Regulations.gov dockets the period is anchored to; `[]` for a Register notice naming none. |
| `open_date` | `VARCHAR` | Eastern day the period opens: a document's comment start (else its posting) or the notice's publication, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `close_date` | `VARCHAR` | Eastern day the merged period closes, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `source` | `VARCHAR` | The sources of its merged intervals, `+`-joined: `documents.comment_end_date` and `federal_register.comments_close_on`. |
| `opened_by_artifact_ids_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of public URLs of the documents whose interval opens the period on `open_date`. |
| `evidence_ids_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of every record merged into the period: Regulations.gov document ids and dated Register record ids. |
| `method` | `VARCHAR` | How the row was asserted; `deterministic` (computed by rule) throughout. |
| `actor_id` | `VARCHAR` | The builder that asserted the row, with its version (`spicy-regs:comment-periods:v<n>`), bumped when its published rows change. |
| `run_id` | `VARCHAR` | The materialization run that built the snapshot (e.g. `rulemaking-20260927T062656Z`). |
| `asserted_at` | `VARCHAR` | When that run asserted the row, as a UTC ISO 8601 instant. |
| `supersedes_id` | `VARCHAR` | Id of a prior row this one continues; always NULL here. |
| `unresolved_fr_references_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of unresolved Register number references attached to its evidence. |
